portfolio.title: Under the Sea Pirate Cake
portfolio.description: A two-tier, pirate-themed birthday cake. The bottom tier is covered in dark blue fondant and features a white anchor, edible seaweed details, and a crumbled cookie 'sand' base. The top tier is decorated with light blue and white marbled buttercream to simulate waves, and includes sculpted green fondant tentacles, a small treasure chest, and a pink mermaid tail. The cake is finished with black, tattered sails on wooden dowels.

portfolio.title: Mocha Celebration Slice
portfolio.description: A rectangular, multi-layered coffee sponge cake. This design consists of three layers of light sponge, each separated by intricate piping of rich coffee-flavored buttercream. The top is bordered with matching buttercream rosettes and generously decorated with a mix of milk, dark, and white chocolate spheres and shards of hand-made chocolate.

portfolio.title: Gotta Bake 'Em All! Cake
portfolio.description: A round celebration cake expertly decorated to resemble the character Pikachu. The entire cake is covered in vibrant yellow buttercream, applied in a detailed star-tip piping technique to create texture. The character's distinct features are crafted from fondant, including black-tipped ears, black and white eyes, a nose, mouth, and iconic red cheeks.

portfolio.title: Whimsical Unicorn & Rainbow Cake
portfolio.description: A round celebration cake with a light blue fondant base, creating a sky scene. The cake features a prominent, handcrafted fondant rainbow arching across the top, complete with fluffy white fondant clouds at its base. A whimsical, hand-sculpted unicorn figure with a pink mane and golden horn stands on a patch of green fondant grass, appearing to 'eat' a colorful assortment of sprinkles spilling from the rainbow. The design is finished with white cloud and green grass details around the base.

portfolio.title: Fondant Teddy & Booties Cake
portfolio.description: A two-tier celebration cake designed for a baby shower. Both tiers are covered in smooth white fondant and wrapped with a delicate pink ribbon accent. The cake is adorned with a hand-sculpted pink fondant teddy bear, a matching baby bottle, and scattered pink and white fondant flowers. The design is finished with a textured ruffle border and topped with a pair of handcrafted pink baby booties.

portfolio.title: Bon Voyage Celebration Cake
portfolio.description: A custom-sculpted cake designed to look like a realistic vintage suitcase. The entire cake is covered in tan-colored fondant, featuring meticulously crafted details like stitched leather-effect straps, metallic-dusted buckles, corner protectors, and a central handle. A red fondant flag is tucked under a strap for a pop of color, making this design perfect for a farewell or bon voyage celebration.

portfolio.title: Happy Scoops Birthday Cake
portfolio.description: A tall, 3D sculpted cake designed to look like a triple-scoop ice cream cone. The structure stands on a realistic, textured fondant waffle cone base. It features three large, stacked scoops of 'ice cream'—in white, purple, and pink—each decorated with a unique and friendly fondant character face. The top scoop is finished with a sweet pink drizzle, a topping of colourful sprinkles, and a classic red fondant cherry.

portfolio.title: Hole-in-One Celebration Cake
portfolio.description: A round celebration cake themed as a personal golf green, perfect for any golf enthusiast. The top features a smooth green fondant putting surface with a custom 'Happy Birthday' message, a hole with a red flag, and a single golf ball ready to be sunk. The design includes a realistic sand trap made from crumbled cookie and is bordered by detailed green buttercream grass piping that continues down the sides of the cake.

portfolio.title: Personalized Character Drip Cake
portfolio.description: A charming character birthday cake with a rich chocolate drip finish. This single-tier, round cake is covered in white fondant, providing a clean canvas for the thick, chocolate-colored drip. The design features a cute, minimalist character face, fondant cat-like ears, and a decorative pink bow. Colorful sprinkles accent the chocolate topping, which is crowned by a large fondant number '7'.

portfolio.title: Elegant Rose & Gold Accent Cakes
portfolio.description: A pair of elegant, individual-sized wedding cakes designed for a sophisticated celebration. Each cake is covered in white fondant featuring a classic quilted pattern with delicate gold dot accents. A simple white ribbon is tied around the circumference, and the design is finished with a topping of fresh, cream-colored roses. This style is perfect for intimate weddings or as a feature for the main table.

portfolio.title: Elegant Buttercream Drip Cake
portfolio.description: An elegant, single-tier drip cake with a soft color palette. The sides feature a delicate watercolor effect in pink and white buttercream with a clean white chocolate ganache drip. A border of chocolate sprinkles trims the base. The top holds a pool of smooth fruit curd, encircled by meticulously piped pink and white buttercream rosettes lightly decorated with chocolate sprinkles.

portfolio.title: African Heritage Celebration Cake
portfolio.description: A striking three-tier wedding cake celebrating traditional Zulu heritage. The white fondant base tier features a braided border, while the royal blue middle tier is adorned with a draped golden sash and motifs inspired by traditional art and beadwork. The top tier is masterfully sculpted to resemble a clay pot (ukhamba), detailed with intricate, colorful piped patterns. The design is crowned with a plume of natural feathers, creating a meaningful centerpiece for a traditional wedding.

portfolio.title: Custom Character Cake Topper
portfolio.description: A detailed, hand-sculpted fondant cake topper of a Minion character. This custom figure features the character's signature look, including blue overalls with texture and stitch details, silver-painted goggles, and black gloves. The character is sculpted in a seated position, ready to be placed on any celebration cake to add a professional, personalized touch.

portfolio.title: Semi-Naked Botanical Wedding Cake
portfolio.description: A two-tier, semi-naked wedding cake combining rustic charm with modern elegance. Each tier features a light coating of buttercream and a rich, dark green ganache drip. The cake is lavishly decorated with fresh cream-colored roses, complementary greenery, and delicate filler flowers. Touches of edible gold paint on select leaves and buds add a hint of glamour to the design.

portfolio.title: Mixed-Finish Floral Wedding Cake
portfolio.description: A unique three-tier wedding cake that combines multiple popular styles in one cohesive design. The bottom tier features smooth white fondant, the middle tier is a rich chocolate drip cake, and the top tier showcases a rustic semi-naked finish. A lush cascade of fresh white roses and delicate sprays of blue baby's breath flows down the side, and the cake is completed with an elegant gold 'Mr & Mrs' topper.

portfolio.title: Potjie Pot Wedding Cake
portfolio.description: A proud three-tier wedding cake celebrating traditional South African heritage. The white fondant base is adorned with a striking geometric pattern inspired by traditional beadwork. The middle tier is elegantly wrapped in blue satin ribbons. The cake is crowned with a hand-sculpted black potjie pot—a symbol of community and celebration—and the entire design is unified with deep blue roses and accented with delicate feathers.

portfolio.title: Personalized Overload Drip Cake
portfolio.description: A vibrant and fully loaded drip cake, perfect for a fun-filled boy's birthday. This tall, single-tier cake is frosted in bright blue buttercream and features a contrasting, glossy red drip. The top is piled high with an assortment of treats, including French macarons, Ferrero Rocher chocolates, wafer sticks, colorful candies, and a fondant soccer ball. The cake is finished with a custom name and age topper.

portfolio.title: Gold-Accent Elephant Topper
portfolio.description: An adorable, hand-sculpted baby elephant cake topper crafted from fondant. This sweet figure features large, expressive ears, delicate eyelashes, and is adorned with a custom bow with a gold star pattern. Subtle, hand-painted gold accents on the trim complete the elegant look. It's the perfect finishing touch for a baby shower, christening, or first birthday cake.

portfolio.title: Elegant Bear & Macaron Drip Cake
portfolio.description: An elegant drip cake with a gentle pastel blue theme, perfect for a baby shower. This tall, single-tier cake is frosted in smooth light blue buttercream and features a creamy white chocolate drip. The top is beautifully decorated with a central, hand-made teddy bear figure, fresh white roses, artistic white chocolate shards, and delicate blue and white meringue kisses. Light blue French macarons are placed on top and at the base to complete the design.

portfolio.title: Gold Leaf & Macaron Celebration Cake
portfolio.description: An elegant two-tier cake featuring a romantic pink and gold color palette. The cake is frosted in a soft, pink watercolor-style buttercream, with a stunning cascade of edible gold leaf flowing down the side for a touch of luxury. The design is finished with an arrangement of fresh pink and white roses, delicate dried flowers, and both pink and gold-painted French macarons.

portfolio.title: Hand-Sculpted Rubble Figure
portfolio.description: A detailed, hand-sculpted fondant cake topper of Rubble from the popular children's show, PAW Patrol. This figure is meticulously crafted to capture the character's signature look, including his yellow construction uniform and pup tag. Each character is made to order and can be part of a full set to bring the whole team to a birthday celebration.

portfolio.title: Heart of Support Buttercream Cake
portfolio.description: A heart-shaped cake entirely covered in delicate, hand-piped white buttercream rosettes. This thoughtful design is decorated with several handcrafted fondant elements: a pink awareness ribbon, a pencil, and a personal note that reads, 'To good times and through bad times.' It's a heartfelt way to show appreciation, support, or to celebrate a milestone for healthcare professionals.

portfolio.title: Dog Lover's Custom Birthday Cake
portfolio.description: A charming, tall birthday cake designed for a young dog lover. This single-tier cake features a beautiful blue ombré buttercream finish, with black fondant paw prints climbing up the sides. The top creates a playful scene with several different breeds of hand-sculpted fondant dogs, complete with cute details like a bone and a food bowl. The design is finished with a personalized, glittery name topper.

portfolio.title: Bright Sunflower Sugar Cookies
portfolio.description: A batch of custom-decorated, rectangular sugar cookies with a cheerful sunflower theme. Each cookie is topped with a smooth layer of vibrant teal icing and artfully decorated with hand-piped yellow sunflowers, complete with dark centers and green stems. These are perfect as party favors, for dessert tables, or as a bright, sweet treat for any occasion.

portfolio.title: Vanilla Sponge with Strawberries & Cream
portfolio.description: An elegant, rectangular layer cake piled high with fresh strawberries and chocolate. This celebration slice features two thick layers of light vanilla sponge, separated by a generous layer of smooth vanilla cream. The top is bordered with matching piped cream rosettes. The center is lavishly decorated with a mix of fresh, juicy strawberries, decadent chocolate-dipped strawberries, and artistic shards of both white and dark chocolate.

portfolio.title: Enchanted Unicorn Birthday Cake
portfolio.description: A magical unicorn-themed birthday cake. This single-tier cake is covered in smooth white buttercream and decorated with a whimsical swirl of rainbow-colored buttercream 'hair' cascading down the top and sides. It features a tall, elegant golden fondant horn and delicate white fondant ears with gold-painted inner details. The unicorn's sweet face is completed with simple black piped eyelashes.

portfolio.title: Two-Tier Sunflower Drip Cake
portfolio.description: A bright and cheerful two-tier celebration cake with a rustic yet elegant sunflower theme. Both tiers are frosted in smooth white buttercream and feature a luscious, golden caramel drip. The cake is beautifully adorned with large, fresh sunflowers, complemented by delicate white roses and sprays of baby's breath.

portfolio.title: Fun Watermelon Birthday Cake
portfolio.description: A creative and playful tall cake designed to look just like a juicy slice of watermelon. The buttercream exterior features striped green and white rind details at the base, with the main body in a vibrant pink. Teardrop-shaped black fondant 'seeds' are dotted around the sides, and the design is finished with a 'Happy Birthday' message on top.

portfolio.title: Ultimate Candy Explosion Cake
portfolio.description: A vibrant and playful drip cake featuring a pastel rainbow and an explosion of sweet treats. The sides are decorated with soft, horizontal stripes of rainbow-colored buttercream and topped with a creamy white chocolate drip. The cake is lavishly decorated with a variety of confections, including a giant lollipop, a handcrafted fondant rainbow, meringue kisses, cookies, and an assortment of colorful candies.

portfolio.title: Surprise Kittens Novelty Cake
portfolio.description: An adorable novelty birthday cake designed to look like a charming gift box full of kittens. The cake is covered in light pink fondant with white polka dots. A propped-open lid, topped with a large, elegant white fondant bow, creates the gift box effect. Peeking out from inside are three hand-sculpted fondant kittens—ginger, white, and tabby—each with sweet, detailed faces.

portfolio.title: Funky Llama Birthday Cake
portfolio.description: A fun and funky novelty cake designed to look like a friendly llama. The cake is covered in textured white buttercream to create a 'fur' effect and features a sweet, hand-modelled fondant face with long eyelashes. The llama is decorated with a colorful, fiesta-style blanket and pom-poms made from fondant, and is finished with a custom name and age topper.

portfolio.title: Spider-Man Fondant Toppers
portfolio.description: A set of handcrafted fondant toppers featuring the iconic Spider-Man mask. Each round, red topper is detailed with hand-drawn black webbing and the superhero's classic white eyes. These toppers are perfect for quickly and easily decorating cupcakes or cookies for a superhero-themed party.

portfolio.title: Love Note Sugar Cookies
portfolio.description: A beautiful assortment of hand-decorated sugar cookies, perfect for Valentine's Day. This set features a variety of heart and love-note shapes decorated in a classic palette of pink, white, and red. Designs include elegant script with messages like 'LOVE' and 'BE MINE,' delicate floral piping, and sophisticated quilted patterns.

portfolio.title: Creepy Crawly Birthday Cake
portfolio.description: A fun and muddy chocolate birthday cake, perfect for an adventurous boy who loves creepy crawlies. The cake is frosted with a rustic chocolate buttercream and topped with a generous layer of crushed chocolate cookie 'dirt.' It's brought to life with hand-sculpted fondant creatures, including a large, detailed brown spider and a cute green snake, all nestled amongst lush fondant leaves and personalized with the birthday boy's name.

portfolio.title: Chocolate Lover's Dream Cake
portfolio.description: The ultimate celebration cake for any true chocolate aficionado. This rich, single-tier cake is frosted with a decadent chocolate buttercream and generously topped with a wreath of assorted chocolates and treats. The decorations include Lindt Lindor truffles, Oreo cookies, malted chocolate balls, honeycomb pieces, and colorful chocolate candies.

portfolio.title: Best Friends Fondant Topper
portfolio.description: A heartwarming, hand-sculpted fondant topper featuring a teddy bear and a pony sharing a hug. The pony is crafted from smooth white fondant with sweet, sleepy eyes and pink accents, while the teddy bear has a unique, textured finish to create a soft, fuzzy appearance. This beautiful keepsake topper is perfect for celebrating friendship, a new baby, or a child's birthday.

portfolio.title: Ice Cream Parlor Party Cake
portfolio.description: A cheerful celebration cake decorated with a festival of colorful buttercream piping. The smooth, white buttercream base provides the perfect canvas for the vibrant decorations. The top is completely covered in a dense mosaic of hand-piped rosettes and stars, with a matching border around the base, using a fun, multi-color palette of pink, blue, yellow, purple, and green.

portfolio.title: Elegant Celebration Cake
portfolio.description: An elegant and modern drip cake, perfect for a stylish teen's milestone birthday. The cake features a beautiful watercolor buttercream effect in shades of teal and white, with a creamy white chocolate ganache drip. It is adorned with handcrafted white sugar roses with delicate gold-dusted edges, a bold number '14' topper, and finished with scattered gold and white pearl accents for a touch of sparkle.

portfolio.title: Magical Unicorn Sky Cake
portfolio.description: A whimsical and magical celebration cake, perfect for a unicorn-themed birthday party. The design features a hand-sculpted unicorn figure sitting atop the cake amongst fluffy fondant clouds. A large, colorful pastel rainbow wraps around the front, while a bouquet of pastel 'balloons' creates a festive backdrop. The cake is finished with golden star accents for a touch of magic.

portfolio.title: Simple & Sweet Striped Cake
portfolio.description: A simple and sweet celebration cake with a vibrant two-tone color scheme. The cake features striped blue and purple buttercream around the base, with a clean white buttercream finish on the upper section. A decorative border of alternating blue and purple piped rosettes crowns the top of the cake, making it perfect for birthdays where a splash of color is needed.
